terra.problem: The passage does not say a gong and cymbal make no music. They can be musical instruments.
Asking for the same blessing is not necessarily envy or opposed to love. Paul does not make that claim.
Paul says love is kind between saying it is patient and saying it does not envy. The latter is not the very next thing he says after patience.
The drawer joke alludes to Papa Dorin's backstory without explaining that he spent years in a junk drawer.
Rejoicing in one's own success is not necessarily boasting or self-seeking. Paul does not say it is incompatible with love.
Keeping no account of wrongs does not mean there was nothing done to get even about.
“Yes, sir” assumes the baker's gender and addresses the baker as something other than “baker” or “friend.”
Paul describes a dim reflection as in a mirror; he does not say mirrors generally give blurry versions.
Saying face to face means there will be no mirror at all turns Paul's contrast into a detail the text does not state.
The question paraphrases Paul's words; it is not word for word in the verse.
